name: nvram_ef_sbp_modem_config_struct
xml:
<Struct name="nvram_ef_sbp_modem_config_struct" size="332">
			<Field name="sbp_mode" type_name="kal_uint32" is_typedef="true" type="unsigned int" offset="0" size="4" description="[MCF] SBP ID(Phase out, use NVRAM_EF_SBP_IDS_LID instead)" />
			<Field name="modem_sbp_config" type_name="kal_uint8" is_typedef="true" type="unsigned char" offset="4" size="327" array_sizes="327" description="[MCF,RUNTIME] Configuration of SBP Feature">
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_PERMANENT_AUTO_SEL_MODE" description="Permanent Auto Selection Mode" byte_offset="4" bit_offset="0" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Not Supported" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Supported" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_NRRC_PPOWERCLASS_CUSTOMIZATION_WITH_CORRESPONDING_BAND_FOR_S_CRITERIA" description="Ppowerclass customization with specific band in NVRAM value" byte_offset="4" bit_offset="1" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Disabled" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Enabled" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_UMTS_CB_OFF" description="Configure Cell Broadcast enabling in UMTS network" byte_offset="4" bit_offset="2" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Cell Broadcast in UMTS network is enabled" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Cell Broadcast in UMTS network is disabled" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_MM_TRY_ABNORMAL_LAI_ONCE_MORE" description="If only one PLMN is available and this PLMN was already rejected four times (i.e. attempt counter >=4), the terminal device shall attempt to access the already rejected network once more." byte_offset="4" bit_offset="3" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Disable. Do not apply the rule of for Steer of Roaming (Managed Roaming)" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Enable. apply the rule of for Steer of Roaming (Managed Roaming)" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_MM_DISABLE_RETRY_ABNORMAL_LAI" description="Modem retries abnormal LAI/RAI/TAI when T3212/T3302/T3402 expiry." byte_offset="4" bit_offset="4" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. Modem retries abnormal LAI/RAI/TAI after 10/15/15 minutes" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. Modem retries abnormal LAI/RAI/TAI when T3212/T3302/T3402 expiry" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_DISABLE_AUTO_RETURN_PRE_RPLMN" description="Disable the mechanism to automatically return to previous registered PLMN." byte_offset="4" bit_offset="5" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. UE returns to previous RPLMN" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. UE does not return to previous RPLMN" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_MM_HPPLMN_1ST_ATTEMPT_ENHANCE" description="When the SBP is on, UE will apply the first higher priority scan timer when UE is registered on a VPLMN for \"Power on\", \"Out Of Service\" and \"Manual selection\". If SBP_DISABLE_2MIN_MINIMUM_HPPLMN_TIMER is off , the first higher priority PLMN scan timer will be 2 min." byte_offset="4" bit_offset="6" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. Do not apply the timer of first higher priority PLMN scan" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. Apply the timer of first higher priority PLMN scan" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_OOS_EARLY_IND" description="Configure early OOS indication reporting" byte_offset="4" bit_offset="7" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Early OOS indication reporting is disabled" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Early OOS indication reporting is enabled" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_L2_RANDOM_FILL_BIT" description="Enable L2 Random Fill Bits Support " byte_offset="5" bit_offset="0" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Not Supported" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Supported" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_3G_CB_SERVICE_BY_PLMN" description="in 3G, CB service enabled/disabled decided by PLMN or not" byte_offset="5" bit_offset="1" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Disabled. In 3G, CB service enabled/disabled not decided by PLMN" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Enabled. In 3G, CB service enabled/disabled decided by PLMN" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_MM_IGNORE_EQPLMN_IN_MANUAL_MODE" description="Whether to ignore EQPLMN in manual mode" byte_offset="5" bit_offset="2" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. Do not ignore EQPLMN in manual mode" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. Ignore EQPLMN in manual mode" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_MM_IGNORE_OP274_EQPLMN" description="Ignore equivalent PLMNs if registered PLMN is OP274." byte_offset="5" bit_offset="3" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Disabled. Do not ignore EPLMNs if registered PLMN is OP274" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Enabled. Ignore EPLMNs if registered PLMN is OP274" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_MM_IGNORE_PLAY_EQPLMN" description="Ignore equivalent PLMNs if registered PLMN is OP161." byte_offset="5" bit_offset="4" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Disabled. Do not ignore EPLMNs if registered PLMN is OP161" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Enabled. Ignore EPLMNs if registered PLMN is OP161" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_MM_IGNORE_EQPLMN_IN_AUTO_MODE" description="Whether to ignore EQPLMN in auto mode" byte_offset="5" bit_offset="5" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. Do not ignore EQPLMN in auto mode" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. Ignore EQPLMN in auto mode" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_MM_INTERNATIONAL_HPPLMN_SEARCH" description="Require UE to perform international HPPLMN search when it registers on a US PLMN and the HPPLMN belongs to Canada" byte_offset="5" bit_offset="6" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Disabled. Not search HPPLMNs in other countries" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Enabled. Search HPPLMNs in other countries" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_OP07_HPPLMN_SEARCH" description="Perform background search to higher priority PLMNs and treat north America MCCs are in the same country." byte_offset="5" bit_offset="7" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Disabled. Not treat north America MCCs as in the same country" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Enabled. Treat north America MCCs as in the same country" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_HPPLMN_REGARDLESS_ANY_MCC" description="Allow UE to perform background search to higher priority PLMNs without MCC restriction." byte_offset="6" bit_offset="0" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. Background search to HPPLMN with MCC restriction" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. Background search to HPPLMN without MCC restriction" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_DISABLE_RPLMN_FROM_GLOCI" description="Disable the strategy that UE gets the RPLMN from GLOCI." byte_offset="6" bit_offset="1" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. Allow to use RPLMN from GLOCI" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. Disable RPLMN from GLOCI" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_DISABLE_PLMNSEL_OPLMN_COEXIST" description="Disable ef_plmnsel and ef_oplmn both taking effect" byte_offset="6" bit_offset="2" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. ef_plmnsel and ef_oplmn both take effect" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. Disable ef_plmnsel and ef_oplmn both taking effect" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_DISABLE_DISPLAY_ROAMING_HPLMN_IN_EPLMN" description="Display roaming while HPLMN is assigned in equivalent PLMN list." byte_offset="6" bit_offset="3" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. Display roaming while HPLMN is in EQPLMNs" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. Not display roaming while HPLMN is in EQPLMNs" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_MM_SEARCH_HPLMN_BEFORE_RPLMN" description="Search HPLMN before RPLMN" byte_offset="6" bit_offset="4" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. Search RPLMN before HPLMN" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. Search HPLMN before RPLMN" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_DISABLE_PLMN_SEL_WHEN_ACCESS_BARRED" description="allow UE to stay at access barred cell instead of searching other networks for normal service." byte_offset="6" bit_offset="5" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. Search other networks for normal service" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. Stay at access barred cell" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_OP08_PLMN_MATCHING" description="To prevent the issue of network configuration, treat OP08 31026f and 310260 as equivalent" byte_offset="6" bit_offset="6" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. Not treat OP08 PLMNs as matching" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. Treat OP08 PLMNs as matching" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_MM_NOT_TRY_ANOTHER_RAT_FOR_LU_ABNORMAL" description="Skip other RAT for registration abnormal case." byte_offset="6" bit_offset="7" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. Not skip other RAT of the current PLMN" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. Skip other RAT of the current PLMN" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_ENS" description="To support the requirement of OP07 Enhanced Network Selection (ENS)." byte_offset="7" bit_offset="0" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. Not support ENS" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. Support ENS" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_RESUME_GPRS_AFTER_LU_ABNORMAL" description="Configure resume of PS session after abnormal LU" byte_offset="7" bit_offset="1" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Do not resume PS session after abnormal LU" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Resume PS session after abnormal LU" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_OP08_ECC_NOTIFICATION_ENABLE" description="Configure OP08 ECC Notification" byte_offset="7" bit_offset="2" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:USSD not supported while ECC is ongoing but integrity is OFF" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:USSD is supported while ECC is ongoing but integrity is OFF" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_ENS_RAT_BALANCING" description="dynamically load balances 3G ME to different RAT mode settings" byte_offset="7" bit_offset="3" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Not Supported" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Supported" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_OP03_H_PLUS" description="OP03 requirement to display symbol in idle mode based on cell's max capabilities" byte_offset="7" bit_offset="4" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Not Supported" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Supported" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_USIM_CSP_SUPPORT" description="To Support CSP file Under USIM Application" byte_offset="7" bit_offset="5" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Not Supported" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Supported" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_SAT_NO_EVDL_IN_SESSION" description="Store and reissue event download envelope when in SAT session" byte_offset="7" bit_offset="6" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Disable. Send Event Download during SAT session." />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Enable. DO NOT send Event Download until the end of SAT session" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_IMEI_LOCK_SUPPORT" description="To Support Verification of IMEI before camping on Network" byte_offset="7" bit_offset="7" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Not Supported" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Supported" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_OP17_IOT_SMS" description="Enable MO SMS Retry forOP17 IOT test" byte_offset="8" bit_offset="0" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Don't allow the SMS to be retried" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Allow the SMS to be retried" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_USE_SM_QOS_SUBSCRIBED" description="SM use QoS Subscribed Value" byte_offset="8" bit_offset="1" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Not Supported" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Supported" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_NO_SUPPORT_A5_3" description="Disable A5_3 Encryption Algorithm " byte_offset="8" bit_offset="2" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:The A5/3 ciphering algorithm is supported by UE" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:The A5/3 ciphering algorithm is not supported by UE" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_OP17_IOT_CC" description="Handle primitive facility after or before peer connect ack for OP17 IOT" byte_offset="8" bit_offset="3" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:FACILITY will be sent before CONNECT ACK" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:FACILITY will be sent after CONNECT ACK" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_AT_ME_IDENTIFICATION_WITHOUT_HEADER" description="This feature is used to display prefix string of intermediate result of AT+CGMM,AT+CGMR and AT+CGMI command" byte_offset="8" bit_offset="4" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Disable ME identification without HEADER" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Enable ME identification without HEADER" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_STAR_SHORT_STRING_AS_CALL" description="Short string is intended to be treated as CC operation" byte_offset="8" bit_offset="5" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Short string should not be treated as CC operation" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Short string is intended to be treated as CC operation" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_CUSTOMIZED_IDLE_STRING_AS_CALL" description="Idle string is intended to be treated as CC operation" byte_offset="8" bit_offset="6" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Idle string is intended to be treated as USSD operation" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Idle string is intended to be treated as CC operation" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_DISABLE_SKIP_NEW_FPLMN_MANUAL_RESEL" description="Disable skipping new FPLMN when manual reselection." byte_offset="8" bit_offset="7" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. Skip new FPLMN when manual reselection" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. Not skip newe FPLMN when manual reselection" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_ADAPTIVE_PAGING_PERIOD_IN_UNACK_MODE" description="Adaptive Paging Period in UNACK Mode Enabled " byte_offset="9" bit_offset="0" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:the paging period will not be changed when RLC in UNACK mode" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:the paging period will be changed when RLC in UNACK mode" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_BG_SEARCH_2G4_FDD" description="2G FDD to LTE Background Search Enabled " byte_offset="9" bit_offset="1" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:UE doesn't support 4G background search in 2G" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:UE supports 4G background search in 2G" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_BG_SEARCH_3G4_FDD" description="3G FDD to LTE Background Search Enabled " byte_offset="9" bit_offset="2" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Not Supported" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Supported" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_BG_SEARCH_2G4_TDD" description="2G TDD to LTE Background Search Enabled " byte_offset="9" bit_offset="3" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Not Supported" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Supported" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_BG_SEARCH_3G4_TDD" description="3G TDD to LTE Background Search Enabled " byte_offset="9" bit_offset="4" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Not Supported" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Supported" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_OP01_TEST_MODE_CONSIDER_SIM" description="OP01_TEST_MODE_CONSIDER_SIM" byte_offset="9" bit_offset="5" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Not Supported" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Supported" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_DISABLE_EUTRAN_AFTER_ABNORMAL" description="Disable EUTRAN after network abnormal failure" byte_offset="9" bit_offset="6" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. Not disable EUTRAN for the abnormal network" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. Disable EUTRAN for the abnormal network" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_DISABLE_RPLMN_FROM_EPSLOCI" description="Disable the strategy that UE gets the RPLMN from EPSLOCI." byte_offset="9" bit_offset="7" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. Allow to use RPLMN from EPSLOCI" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. Disable RPLMN from EPSLOCI" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_DISABLE_EUTRAN_AFTER_NO_SUITABLE" description="Disable EUTRAN after network reject no suitable cause." byte_offset="10" bit_offset="0" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Turn-off. Not disable EUTRAN after rejection by no suitable cell cause" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Turn-on. Disable EUTRAN after rejection by no suitable cell cause" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_MM_NOT_STAY_ON_FBLA_FOR_REG_PROV" description="Add LAI in the list of 'forbidden location areas for roaming' if reject cause 12 is received." byte_offset="10" bit_offset="1" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:not supported" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Supported" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_NO_OPTIONAL_RAU_AFTER_CCO_FAILURE" description="No optional RAU after CCO failure" byte_offset="10" bit_offset="2" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Not Supported" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Supported" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_EMR_REPORTING_WITH_SI2Q_BSIC_PARA" description="EMR with SI2Q BSIC Param Enabled " byte_offset="10" bit_offset="3" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:UE doesn't support Enhanced Measurement Reporting by SI2quater and SI5series" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:UE supports Enhanced Measurement Reporting by SI2quater and SI5series" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_AMR_WB_GSM" description="This feature is used to enable/disable AMR-WB codec in GSM" byte_offset="10" bit_offset="4" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Disable AMR-WB codec in GSM" />
					<Bit_Value value="1" description="1:Enable AMR-WB codec in GSM" />
				</NVRAM_Bit_Data>
				<NVRAM_Bit_Data name="SBP_AMR_WB_UMTS" description="This feature is used to enable/disable AMR-WB codec in UMTS" byte_offset="10" bit_offset="5" bit_count="1">
					<Bit_Value value="0" description="0:Disable AMR-WB codec in UMTS" />
